source.label: Held-out ALE evaluation episode outputs
assumptions: The three training seeds were selected before the full runs.
The six DQN checkpoints used matched 250,000-decision budgets and differ only by replay type within each seed.
The random policy uses the same evaluation wrapper and reset seeds.
Three training seeds provide limited evidence about algorithm-level differences.

metricDefinitions.label: Evaluation episode reward
metricDefinitions.definition: Unclipped game score accumulated during one held-out episode.

metricDefinitions.label: Evaluation episode length
metricDefinitions.definition: Selected actions before game termination or the 4,500-action cap.

source.label: Per-seed summaries computed from held-out episode outputs

metricDefinitions.label: Mean evaluation reward
metricDefinitions.definition: Arithmetic mean of ten held-out episode rewards within one policy and training seed.

metricDefinitions.label: Across-seed spread
metricDefinitions.definition: Standard deviation across three per-seed mean rewards; this describes seed variation and is not a confidence interval.

methods.code: Group the ten recorded evaluation episode rewards by replay policy and training seed; compute count, mean, sample standard deviation, minimum and maximum.

source.label: Episode-level training logs for six matched DQN runs
filters: Training horizon: 250,000 selected-action decisions per run

metricDefinitions.label: Training episode reward
metricDefinitions.definition: Unclipped ALE score recorded during training under the current epsilon-greedy behavior policy.

metricDefinitions.label: Environment decisions
metricDefinitions.definition: Selected actions. Each selected action repeats across four emulator frames in the configured wrapper.

methods.code: Plot raw training episode rewards against environment_steps, separately by replay method and seed. The training logs contain episode reward, not evaluation reward.
